The market state here is the resolver CRT state. `CRTStateResolver` builds it from the `when:` blocks in `configs/formulas/market_crt_states.yaml`. A block matches when every named feature is in one of its listed states. Empty `when:` matches nothing in the states loop.

The file declares 16 feature states. The `when:` blocks name 14 of them once `LINK-001` is on, and 13 while every link is off. The default constructor leaves every link off, so a normal `CRTStateResolver()` requires the 13. Variant `choch` turns `LINK-001` on and requires the 14. The 14th name is `change_of_character`.

`FeatureStateEncoder` knows 19 ontology features that declare states. Thirteen of those are vector-bound. The resolver roster is the 16 below. The three ontology states outside that roster are `body_commitment`, `atr_magnitude`, and `momentum_magnitude` (`crt_state_resolver.py` names them next to the three non-vector predicate features).

## The 14 that the when: blocks name

Counted from a live `CRTStateResolver(variant="choch")` after link filtering. `idx` is the canonical vector slot. A blank idx is a non-vector column the caller must pass beside the vector.

| change_of_character | FM-083 | 47 | BearishCHoCH, NoCHoCH, BullishCHoCH | DISPLACEMENT, and only while LINK-001 is on |

## when: blocks the resolver holds

Default, every link off. `change_of_character` is absent. Required set size 13.

| CRT state | requires_memory | when: |
|---|---|---|
| EXECUTION | yes | retest_flag: RetestActive; trend_bias: Bullish or Bearish; rsi_state: NeutralMomentum; session: LONDON, NEWYORK, or OVERLAP |
| RETEST | yes | retest_flag: RetestActive; sweep_detected: SweepDetected; break_of_structure: NoBreak |

| SHADOW_PENDING | yes | empty |
| SWEEP | no | liquidity_sweep: SellSideSweep or BuySideSweep; break_of_structure: NoBreak; displacement_flag: NoDisplacement |
| EXPIRED | yes | empty |
| RESOLUTION | yes | empty |
| RANGE | no | liquidity_sweep: NoSweep; break_of_structure: NoBreak; sweep_detected: NoSweep; displacement_flag: NoDisplacement; double_sweep: NoDoubleSweep; higher_high: NoHigherHigh; lower_low: NoLowerLow; retest_flag: NoRetest; swing_high: NoSwingHigh; swing_low: NoSwingLow |

Variant `choch` (`links: [LINK-001]`). Same blocks, and DISPLACEMENT gains one clause. Required set size 14.

DISPLACEMENT when: displacement_flag: Displacement; change_of_character: BullishCHoCH or BearishCHoCH.

`_check_resolution` reuses the RANGE `when:` while the resolver memory is EXECUTION. A RANGE match there returns RESOLUTION.

## When a when: block is actually reached

Active thresholds: `sweep_geometry: htf_range`, `continuous_disp_to_expansion: false`. Several returns happen before the states loop (`crt_state_resolver.py` `_resolve_from_features`).

| CRT state | What decides it on the default path |
|---|---|
| EXPANSION | While memory is already EXPANSION, the function returns `expansion_dwell_hold` before any `when:` test. The displacement_flag clause is not what holds the state. |
| SWEEP | A new sweep from RANGE returns at `htf_founding_sweep` from range geometry. The SWEEP `when:` runs only while memory is already SWEEP. |
| DISPLACEMENT | From SWEEP, a pass of the continuous displacement gate returns at `funnel_displacement` before the loop. The DISPLACEMENT `when:` runs while memory is already DISPLACEMENT. With links off that clause is displacement_flag. With LINK-001 it also requires change_of_character. |
| SHADOW_PENDING | Empty `when:`. Entered from pending-displacement memory plus a matching sweep. |
| EXPIRED | Empty `when:`. TTL while memory is EXPANSION, before the loop. |
| RESOLUTION | Empty `when:`. From EXECUTION, either the RANGE `when:` matches or the execution age cap fires. |
| RETEST | The RETEST `when:` is tested in the states loop, then the continuous retest-depth gate, and only if memory is already EXPANSION or RETEST. |
| EXECUTION | The EXECUTION `when:` is tested in the loop, then the depth gate, and the score gate fails closed when no score is supplied. Memory must already be RETEST or EXECUTION. |
| RANGE | The RANGE `when:` is the ground predicate in the loop. A bar that matches nothing else also falls through to RANGE. |

## What each engine state reads

The engine is `src/config_layer/crt_engine_v2.py`. `process_candle` takes a candle, an HTF id, and optional parent bias. It does not take the 14 feature states. Entry is `StateMachine` plus `RangeDetector.detect_sweep`.

| Engine state | Entered by | Inputs that gate the entry |
|---|---|---|
| RANGE | `reset_to_range` | Reset reason (HTF, gap, age, session filter, and the other reset callers). |
| SWEEP | `try_range_to_sweep` after `detect_sweep` | candle high, low, close against `active_range.h_ref` and `l_ref`. |
| SHADOW_PENDING | `try_range_to_shadow_pending` | A sweep whose direction equals `pending_displacement_dir`. |
| DISPLACEMENT | `try_sweep_to_displacement` | Direction in {LONG, SHORT}; LONG close above open and above sweep price; SHORT close below open and below sweep price; abs(close-open) against `atr_min_displacement * atr_abs`; sweep age against `max_sweep_age_candles`; `body_ratio` (FM-010) against `body_ratio_min`; `wick_size` (FM-002 candle range) against `atr_multiplier_min * atr_abs`. |
| EXPANSION | `try_displacement_to_expansion`, or the shadow collapse | Close versus open in the trade direction; close beyond the displacement close; abs(close - displacement close) against `expansion_atr_min_distance * atr_abs`. The shadow path skips the strength check. |
| RETEST | `try_expansion_to_retest` | Close versus the active-range boundary; ATR; `retest_min_depth_atr_fraction`, `retest_depth_max`, `retest_atr_depth_fraction`; FM-028 `displacement_atr_ratio` against `max_displacement_strength`. On a pass it writes a cache: FM-027 `displacement_retrace`, `body_ratio`, FM-028, the range's session string, and `sweep_event.double_confirmed`. |
| EXECUTION | `try_retest_to_execution` | The transition itself reads no feature. The trade-open path in front of it applies the session-window filter (`allowed_sessions`) and the risk approval. |
| RESOLUTION | `try_execution_to_resolution` | The close reason string. |
| EXPIRED | expansion TTL inside `process_candle` | Expansion age in candles and an M15 hour approximation, against `max_expansion_age_candles` and `max_expansion_age_hours`. The integrity event also reads `body_ratio` on the displacement candle. The next bar resets EXPIRED to RANGE. |

Of the 14 `when:` names, the engine file touches three strings, and each touch is a different object from the feature state:

| Name | Where the engine reads it |
|---|---|
| session | Session-window filter on the trade-open path, and `active_range.session` copied into `cached_features`. That string is the range's session label. The resolver's EXECUTION clause tests the FM-052 state. |
| double_sweep | `sweep_event.double_confirmed` stored as a boolean on `cached_features`, then read by `_derive_trade_intent`. The resolver's RANGE clause tests the FM-060 state `NoDoubleSweep`. |
| sweep_detected | `_derive_trade_intent` calls `features.get("sweep_detected")`. The comment on that function says the key is absent from the six-key cache, so the `liq_sweep` branch rests on the boolean `double_sweep`. The trace label `no_sweep_detected` in the RANGE branch is the detector returning no sweep. |

The other eleven `when:` names do not appear as engine entry inputs: `break_of_structure`, `change_of_character`, `displacement_flag`, `higher_high`, `liquidity_sweep`, `lower_low`, `retest_flag`, `rsi_state`, `swing_high`, `swing_low`, `trend_bias`. `volatility_regime` and `volume_spike` are in the same position: declared on the resolver roster, unused by any `when:`, unused by engine entry.

So the 14 feature states build the resolver market state. The engine states are entered from candle geometry, range memory, ATR, body ratio, and candle range.

Joined the engine geometry gates to the feature schema on the active config `v2_htfcrt_2026_08`. Three homes hold the numbers. A few keys already name the same quantity and can share one value. The body cuts, the retest constructions, the EMA spans, and the session windows are separate quantities that happen to sit near each other.

No source or config edit. Record stays on `userinvestigation/session_conversation_grok_20260927_1754`.

## Where the numbers live

| Home | What it owns |
|---|---|
| `feature_pipeline` in `v2_htfcrt_2026_08.json` | Periods and cuts that emit feature values and the 14 feature states. Geometric primitives (`body_ratio`, `candle_range`) stay formula-owned in `candle_math`. |
| `params` plus `crt_engine` in the same file | `CRTConfig`. This is what `crt_engine_v2` reads on entry. |
| `market_crt_states.yaml` `thresholds:` | A second literal copy the resolver reads. `threshold_refs` already names which copy matches a `CRTConfig` field. The resolver still reads the literal, not the ref. |

## Keys that can share one value

These match on the active config today. Pointing the resolver at the production key would keep the same number.

| Key | Production | Resolver literal | Feature-schema side |
|---|---|---|---|
| atr period | `crt_engine.atr_period` 14 | `range_atr_period` 14, ref `atr_period` | `feature_pipeline.atr_period` 14 |
| body_ratio_min | `params` 0.65 | 0.65, consumed | FM-010 `body_ratio` is the column. The gate number stays 0.65. |
| atr_multiplier_min | `params` 1.0 | 1.0, consumed | Compared with FM-002 candle range. |
| atr_min_displacement | `crt_engine` 1.2 | 1.2, consumed | Body move in price, times absolute ATR. |
| expansion_atr_min_distance | `params` 0.3 | 0.30, consumed | Close distance past the displacement close. |
| retest_depth_max | `params` 0.15 | 0.15, consumed | The engine multiplies this by range size. |
| max_sweep_age_candles | `crt_engine` 20 | 20, consumed | Age counter, no feature column. |
| max_expansion_age_candles / hours | 495 / 124 | 495 / 124, consumed | TTL, no feature column. |
| score_threshold | `crt_engine` 0.45 | 0.45, consumed | Risk score, no feature column. |
| soft_conf_max_candles | `crt_engine` 3 | 3, consumed | Window length. |
| pending_displacement_ttl_candles | `crt_engine` 4 | `lifecycle` 4, consumed | Memory TTL. |
| rsi_overbought / rsi_oversold | not a CRTConfig field | 70 / 30, and the resolver does not read them | `feature_pipeline` 70 / 30 builds FM-068 `rsi_state` |

`atr_period` is the clean period share. One 14 can feed the feature ATR, the engine ATR, and the resolver range window. The emitted ATR still has two units: the vector `atr` is close-relative, and `state.atr_abs` is the absolute SMA of true range. The resolver already carries `expansion_atr_is_relative: true` for that unit change. Share the period. Keep the unit conversion.

`rsi_overbought` and `rsi_oversold` already have one live owner: `feature_pipeline`, which writes `rsi_state`. The resolver copies are unused. Those two yaml literals can be retired in favor of the feature-pipeline keys.

FM-010 `body_ratio` and FM-002 candle range are already the same formulas the engine candle properties use. The engine can read those columns. The gate numbers stay the production keys above.

FM-027 `displacement_retrace` and FM-028 `displacement_atr_ratio` are already called through the formula registry inside `try_expansion_to_retest`. That math is shared. `max_displacement_strength` 2.0 is the engine ceiling on FM-028. `feature_pipeline.disp_strength_clip_high` 3.0 is a clip on a different feature. Those two numbers stay apart.

## Keys that stay separate

| Pair | Values on the active config | Why they stay apart |
|---|---|---|
| EMA spans | engine `ema_fast` 2, `ema_slow` 5; feature `ema_fast_span` 9, `ema_slow_span` 21 | Soft-confirmation EMA versus the vector EMA. `retest_flag` measures distance to the span-9 EMA. |
| Session windows | engine filter LONDON 07:00–10:00, NEWYORK 13:00–16:00, ASIA 00:00–03:00; feature `session_windows_utc` ASIA 0–9, LONDON 7–16, NEWYORK 12–21 | The feature comment already splits the market-session label (FM-052) from the trade filter. OVERLAP and CLOSED are derived on the feature side. |
| Body cuts | `displacement_strong_body_mult` 0.6 writes FM-069 when `body_size > candle_range * 0.6`; `params.body_ratio_min` 0.65 is the engine `>=` gate; `confirmation_body_min` 0.6 divides `body_ratio` in the soft-confirmation score (`crt_engine_v2.py` around the body-ratio score); ontology `body_ratio` prose and `body_commitment` band edge still say 0.70 | Four cuts on one ratio. FM-069's own note calls the flag distinct from the engine gate. Collapsing 0.6 and 0.65 would move either the flag or the entry. |
| Retest construction | feature `retest_lookback` 10 and `retest_atr_band_mult` 1.0: a sweep inside 10 bars and close within `1.0 * atr * close` of the span-9 EMA; engine: close versus the HTF range boundary, floor `retest_min_depth_atr_fraction` 0.1, ceiling `max(0.15 * range size, 0.3 * ATR)` | The flag is an EMA-band test. The engine depth is a range-boundary test. `retest_depth` (FM-021) is distance to that same span-9 EMA, clipped 0–1, and is 0 whenever the flag is 0. |
| Retest ATR fraction | production `params.retest_atr_depth_fraction` 0.3; resolver literal 0.50; `CRTConfig` dataclass default 0.50 | The resolver lists the key and does not read it (`threshold_refs` consumed false). The 0.50 is the dataclass default, not the live engine value. |
| ATR number | vector `atr` close-relative; engine `atr_abs` absolute | Same period, different unit. |

`retest_atr_depth_fraction` is the one duplicate that does not match production. Reusing the yaml 0.50 on the engine would move the live ceiling from 0.3 to 0.5. The production 0.3 is the value to keep if that dead resolver literal is ever pointed at a real key.

The ontology sentence on FM-010 still describes the displacement gate as `body_ratio >= 0.70`. The active `params.body_ratio_min` is 0.65. That sentence is stale against this config. Left as found.

## What a reuse pass would actually touch

A parity-shaped pass can wire the matching resolver literals to the production keys already named in `threshold_refs`, and can drop the unused resolver RSI pair in favor of `feature_pipeline.rsi_overbought` / `rsi_oversold`. `atr_period` can be one key across `feature_pipeline`, `crt_engine`, and `range_atr_period`, with the relative-versus-absolute conversion left in place.

The body cuts, the two retest geometries, the two EMA pairs, and the two session-window tables stay as separate params. Sharing those names would redefine a feature or move an entry gate.
